title: Verify the fixed PR5678 nearest-contact falsifier (no new κ)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Add a portable verification certificate for one fixed prerequisite on Ali Romman's [PR #5678](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5678), head `af814f6f3c477fdd13b8f04380a33cf32004966b`. Before the uniquely bound Y=`ADD(144,438,"-1/2",911)` at event 15473, the two immediately preceding complete semantic contacts of 144 are:

| Event | Actual contact |
|---:|---|
| 13344 | `ADD(144,317,"1",356)` |
| 13463 | `ADD(144,530,"1",1035)` |

They are not the required opposite-sign pair from role 140, and both precede R at event 14893. The completed status is `COMPLETED_FIXED_NEAREST_CONTACT_FALSIFIER`. The test stops before source corridor or complete-route queries, powers, pricing, a candidate invoice or construction. No paid saving, new $\kappa$, global obstruction or defect in the published construction is claimed.

## Task and overlap

Publication base: `df0137efd35e11b4445734bf612bdd4c7ebc330c`. The task metadata honestly narrows `complex-new-helper-inventory` to a fixed verification result. All runtime source data is a self-contained committed export with exact byte custody; replay requires no predecessor Git object, network, released module or archive import.

The source owner's released work reports 222435 absorbed-shear placements and 189 whole-block relocations. Their exact matcher coverage of this predicate remains UNKNOWN. This package adds inspectable source custody, unique final-context binding, an explicit exhaustive observer convention, the literal nearest witnesses and complete result reproduction. It does not claim that earlier screens missed the predicate or that different role labels establish novelty. [Discussion #5125](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5125) and neighboring [Discussion #5645](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5645) retain their distinct coordination scopes. The separate publication-value gate permits this focused verification certificate; the post-review's default stopped-nomination caveat is preserved.

## Validation

The original independently reviewed normal/optimized pair completed in 1.0066231779928785 seconds with sampled peak RSS 52,416,512 bytes. Both complete results match SHA256 `18dac3a5092667ab5f5118ed6e953d65d558a8d11066e95cc728a069ec01f50f`; both exits are 0 with empty stderr. Nine negative controls reject and the exact positive synthetic conditional identity passes. The 26 frozen files including the request, plus the independent approval, remain unchanged.

The portable core changes one ROOT assignment only. Each registered command runs that core once and requires the entire original output hash, exact nearest contacts and strict stop, so the normal/optimized pair performs two core executions. Two additional integrity controls reject corrupted WORD/core bytes without decoding mutated input. Both complete original outputs and explicitly sanitized request/review/receipt extracts are retained with original hashes.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-nearest-contact-verification --check-only
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-nearest-contact-verification
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-nearest-contact-verification --check-source-history
```

The verifier also supports a relocated, read-only, Git-free package. Root qualification uses the unchanged 150-second, 512 MiB serial guard with 60-second children. Exact public head `cec109b5bc1854dae75a35346f094db157851708` has the same tree `eb9c1911d1a7f7e06db0d89b7b15bd48d645b58d` as the tested local commit. Metadata, all 30 committed file bytes and full declared-source ancestry passed on that public head. The checkout pair passed in 1.410 seconds (sampled RSS 75,141,120 bytes), and the relocated read-only Git-free pair passed in 1.512 seconds (73,478,144 bytes). Both complete normal/optimized outputs agree and package bytes/modes remain unchanged. These are publication portability checks, separate from the original fixed test; hosted CI is a separate status. Metadata, committed-byte/source-history and replay checks are separate gates. The public grammar is authenticated but archive-member equality is untested; no source module is imported. Endpoint matrices, owned erasure-zero values, native phases/all widths, physical caller, ordinary costs and the whole compiler/funding/BIT/outer conjunction are not admitted.

Apache-2.0 notices remain intact; no independent human or proof-kernel acceptance is implied.

## Open next questions

Stop this exact nomination. Roles 317/530, farther-back contacts, changed signs/charts or longer intervals are not follow-up nominations. A changed question needs a fresh exact-source and ownership gate. No automatic scan or construction follows this result.
